source_references.title: micrograd
source_references.author: Andrej Karpathy
source_references.evidence_scope: Presents a tiny scalar autograd engine and neural-network library that exposes the complete core algorithm while treating the rest as efficiency.
source_references.notes: Repository metadata and original paraphrase only; no source corpus is copied.

source_references.title: Neural Networks: Zero to Hero
source_references.author: Andrej Karpathy
source_references.evidence_scope: Builds neural networks from first principles through exercises, manual backpropagation, train/dev/test splits, and diagnostic inspection of activations and gradients.
source_references.notes: Repository metadata and original paraphrase only; notebooks and videos are not copied.

source_references.title: microgpt
source_references.author: Andrej Karpathy
source_references.evidence_scope: Reduces GPT training and inference to a dependency-free, inspectable implementation containing the dataset, tokenizer, autograd, model, optimizer, training loop, and inference loop.
source_references.notes: Source metadata and original paraphrase only; the article and code are not copied.

principles.statement: Build core learning machinery from first principles when deep understanding and debugging intuition matter.
principles.evidence_note: Three authored projects repeatedly expose complete algorithms through compact implementations and exercises.
context_dependencies: Machine-learning systems where opaque behavior would impede diagnosis

signature_moves.statement: Reduce a complex model pipeline to the smallest complete implementation before adding efficiency and scale.
signature_moves.evidence_note: Both authored sources explicitly separate the complete algorithmic core from efficiency concerns.

likely_objections.statement: Training results without explicit evaluation splits and diagnostic inspection are insufficient evidence of model quality.
likely_objections.evidence_note: The course explicitly teaches train, development, and test splits plus activation and gradient diagnostics.

anti_patterns.statement: Starting with a large framework abstraction can conceal the mechanics needed to understand optimization failures.
anti_patterns.evidence_note: This is a bounded inference from the repeated from-scratch teaching and implementation pattern.
anti_patterns.inference_basis: The authored material repeatedly removes framework machinery and manually derives gradients specifically to build debugging competence.
context_dependencies: Learning, debugging, or validating neural-network implementations
Apply to machine-learning implementation, training, evaluation, and education.
Reassess after the validity window because tooling and model practice change quickly.
